pictures.name: LE1-Into-The-Desert
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. The Judean wilderness: vast pale-gold limestone hills and dry wadis under a wide sky. A single far, small figure in a plain cream cloak walks away from the viewer up a rocky path into the empty hills, seen only from behind, his face never visible, a thin line of green along the distant Jordan River behind him. Late afternoon gold light, long deep blue shadows in the valleys. The walking figure in the middle of the frame. Solitary, resolute, vast. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LE2-Forty-Nights
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, deep blue shadows, faint warm gold light. Night in the Judean desert: a thin figure in a plain cream cloak sits alone on a rock beneath an enormous sky full of stars, seen from behind and far away, wrapped against the cold, his face never visible. Around him only bare stone and dry earth, a faint gold glow of dawn beginning on the far horizon. Deep blue and violet sky. The small seated figure in the middle. Lonely, hungry, prayerful. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LE3-The-Stones
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Close to the ground in the desert at sunset: round, smooth, pale stones scattered on the sand look almost exactly like small loaves of bread in the warm light. Behind them, a figure in a plain cream cloak stands seen only from behind, thin and weary, his face never visible. Across the stones falls a long, dark, shapeless shadow from someone unseen at the edge of the frame. Gold light on the stones, deep blue shadows. The bread-like stones in the middle. Tense, quiet temptation, nothing frightening. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LE4-The-Kingdoms
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. From the summit of a very high mountain, seen from behind, a lone figure in a plain cream cloak stands at the edge, his face never visible. Far below him, spread out in a glowing panorama, the kingdoms of the ancient world: gleaming cities with columns and gold domes, harbors full of ships, armies and caravans, rivers winding to the sea, all shimmering gold as if offered. A long dark shadow beside him. The figure in the middle, the world spread beneath. Grand, tempting, still. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LE5-The-Angels
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Dawn in the Judean desert: a figure in a plain cream cloak sits resting against a boulder, seen from behind and a little to the side so his face is hidden. Around him, two gentle angels with soft white-gold wings and calm lifelike faces, in flowing pale robes, kneel and offer him a clay cup of water and a round loaf. Soft rose and gold sunrise light pouring over the hills, the last blue shadows fading. The group in the middle. Peaceful, tender, restoring. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LE6-Today-Ashes
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, lifelike faces, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, of a modern scene today: Ash Wednesday morning in a Catholic church, a priest in purple vestments gently traces a small cross of grey ash with his thumb on the forehead of a woman in her forties in a navy office blazer, her eyes closed. Behind her a short line of ordinary people waits, a man in a work jacket and a teenager in a hoodie, some already with ash crosses on their foreheads. Soft gold window light, deep blue shadows in the nave. The woman and the priest’s hand in the middle. Humble, honest, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.
